description: This file defines custom placement strategies and interfaces for Orleans grains, including placement scenarios, strategy classes, and a custom attribute for placement.

classes.name: TestCustomPlacementStrategy
classes.description: A custom placement strategy class that determines grain placement based on predefined scenarios.

classes.name: TestPlacementStrategyAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute to specify placement strategies on grain classes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the placement strategy with properties, setting the scenario based on stored properties.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties with the current scenario as a string.

methods.name: GetCustomPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Returns a predefined placement strategy based on the specified scenario.
